texto: Essential vocabulary for hotels and travel: «โรงแรม» (roong-rɛɛm, hotel), «จอง» (jɔɔng, to reserve / to book), «ห้องพัก» (hɔ̂ɔng-phák, guest room) and «กระเป๋า» (grà-bpǎo, suitcase / bag / luggage). At a hotel reception in Thailand, to confirm an earlier booking you say: «ฉันจองห้องพักไว้แล้ว» (I've already booked a room in advance, with «ไว้» indicating an action done beforehand). To ask about availability: «มีห้องว่างไหมครับ/ค่ะ» (Are there any rooms free?).
